title: Essential final answer (1)
description: Essential Criteria: The student's answer for part (1) must be 1.8 × 10⁵ N (or equivalent).

title: Essential final answer (2)
description: Essential Criteria: The student's answer for part (2) must be approximately 11.58 s (or equivalent).

title: Work-energy on horizontal deck
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the work-energy theorem for segment AB to relate traction force, distance, and kinetic energy.

title: Power and energy on incline
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the work-energy theorem for segment BC, accounting for work done by constant power and work against gravity.

title: Correct unit conversions
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly convert the aircraft's mass from tons to kg and the takeoff speed from km/h to m/s.

title: Minimum speed at B
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the minimum speed at point B as 60% of the final takeoff speed.

title: Time calculation for AB
description: Optional Criteria: The student may correctly calculate the time for segment AB using kinematics for uniform acceleration.

title: Sign error for gravity
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student incorrectly assigns the sign for the work done by gravity on the incline (e.g., adds it instead of subtracting).

title: Confusing power with force
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student treats the maximum power on the incline as a constant force, failing to use P = Fv or the work-energy theorem with power.
